en: The image features an old black-and-white postcard. The left half shows a panoramic view of a town with scattered buildings, a church with twin towers, hills in the background, and telegraph poles running through a field. The upper left contains the caption 'Postojna-Adelsberg.' The right half shows handwritten correspondence in a cursive script, a green postage stamp, postmarks, and printed bilingual headings: 'Dopisnica. Korrespondenz-Karte.'
